evd_title: OpenReviewer matched at least one human reviewer recommendation in 55.5% of 400 test papers vs 23.8% for GPT-4o
finding: OpenReviewer matched at least one human reviewer recommendation in 55.5% of 400 test papers vs 23.8% for GPT-4o
P: 400 held-out NeurIPS 2024 + ICLR 2025 papers with OpenReview reviews
I: OpenReviewer (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct full fine-tuned on ~79K reviews); greedy decoding
C: Human reviewer recommendations; GPT-4o (2024-11-20), Claude-3.5-Sonnet, Llama-3.1-8B/70B-Instruct
O: Exact match to >=1 human: 55.5% vs GPT-4o 23.8%; avg error 0.96 vs 2.34
